$comment: MANDATORY, NOT CONVENIENCE. bizapps-accounting is a hard requirement of this app — orders
books revenue on confirm and cash on capture, and PaymentLineEntityServer statically imports
AccountingEngineBase. Without the link below, orders does not typecheck and does not run.
The package.json peer markings still say optional:true; that is KNOWN-WRONG and scheduled to
be fixed the day accounting publishes. See docs/dependency-on-accounting.md.
Local development links to sibling Open App checkouts — the interim stand-in for
`mj app link` (proposed: MemberJunction/MJ#3273).
Applied by scripts/link-local-apps.mjs, which runs on `postinstall` so the links
survive `npm install` (raw symlinks in node_modules are otherwise destroyed by it —
the main defect of `npm link`).
Paths are relative to this file. Client (-ng) packages are deliberately NOT linked:
duplicate @angular/* copies in one browser bundle break DI, which is class-identity
based.
Server-side duplication is safe FOR MEMBERJUNCTION specifically — BaseSingleton stores
instances on globalThis, so one ClassFactory is shared across copies (verified: 32 Orders
+ 22 Accounting registrations in a single registry). That is a property of MJ, not a
general rule, and it does not hold for type-graphql, graphql or reflect-metadata, which
keep state in module-local storage. Two copies of those is two universes: accounting's
decorators register into its copy while buildSchema reads ours, and the API dies with
CannotDetermineGraphQLTypeError on a decorator that is perfectly correct. link-local-apps.mjs
redirects those three onto our copy — see SHARED_IDENTITY there.
